avis.texte: It feels really good on eyes if stored in fridge, but it makes my eyes water all day

avis.titre: I will buy this again.   It's my 3rd pot.
avis.texte: I love how it brightens up my under eye. I even carry it in my purse to touch up during the day.

avis.titre: I use this product daily! Love it.
avis.texte: This has become a staple in my daily routine for moisturizing and lightening the dark circles under my eyes. I absolutely love that it has a built-in color corrector, which saves me an extra step in the morning. It provides excellent hydration and coverage without settling into fine lines, making it a truly fantastic product for mature skin.

avis.titre: Gave me styes on my eye
avis.texte: I gave this a try because I was seeing ads about it. I didn't notice any difference. Only difference I saw was when I had it on. Which makes sense because it comes tinted. After putting it on for a few weeks it gave me three styes! Something I never had to deal with only after I started using this product. I stopped using it and it took almost half a year for one of the styes to go away. It was just a minor bump. Which is still kinda there but not as noticable. I regret getting this product.

I have been using this brightening eye cream for years. They have switched the container from a easy dose mess free tube to a clunky step-neck-down tub that, aside from the fact that it looks half empty, makes it very difficult to access all of the product. Eye cream is something one applies small controlled dabs of, impossible to do with this container. It's not even a wide mouth tub, with that step neck you have to stick your finger in (God forbid you have long nails) and make a mess. I hate that I had to pay to be annoyed on a daily basis. I'm not generally one to leave reviews, that's how much I dislike this container.

avis.titre: Thought it was a sample size
avis.texte: The product is till wonderful but the product size has shrunk.. I thought I had opened a deluxe sample.

I love the employees at ultra in Fall River Massachusetts. They're very helpful and patient and they do know their stuff. I at least spend 150 to 200 every time I go and I'm never disappointed thank you so much girls.❤️
I miss the old formula, now it is very runny kind of texture. Does brighten the area, not too much difference in puffiness.

I've tried numerous eye creams to help reduce fine lines, to lighten my dark circles and bring moisture to the area. This is by far one of the better products I have used to manage my sensitive eye area. I've seen improvements in all three areas with this brightening cream! My undereye area stays moisturized all day and I definitely notice a brighter look to my skin.

avis.titre: Helps dark circles and fine lines
avis.texte: I'm on my 2nd jar. I think it does help dark circles and fine lines. I wear this in the morning. It does not irritate my skin.

avis.titre: The shipping was terrible i ordered 2 eye creams only one
avis.texte: The box was not sealed correctly. had huge gap. i have missing items

I have been using the Ginzing Refreshing Eye Cream for years and loved it until the 'new container.' It says .5fl but it is half empty. I never understood why retailers make changes that don't make sense. Change is good but only if it is for the 'better.' In this case, the new container sucks and it looks way less that .5fl. I am shopping for other eye cream that is not Origins.

I feel really sad to have to rate this a bad review but these companies need to stop being so greedy and frauding the consumer should not be normalized .. first off i've been using this product for years and most recently they changed the packaging . Let me say how disappointing it is that not only is the product half empty but the cream itself feels more watery like they watered it down . it is NOT the same consistency . Second , it's such a scam strategy to change the package to give the appearance of a lot of product but when you open you realize how little product is actually in there even though the rim of the containers looks like you're getting alot more product than you are it is desciveing for the new packaging . I will Or be buying this again

Love the product! It does what it says and reduces my puffy eyes for the day before I put on makeup. The only reason it isn't 5 stars is because I do not like the new packaging. The narrow neck makes it difficult to get to the cream.

avis.titre: The product is great, the new packaging sucks.
avis.texte: I having been using this product for a few years now. I always get it as a Christmas present. This year when I opened the box I saw the new packaging. I first off do not like the new rust almost brown color the orange now is but I can look past that. However when I opened I see that the new packaging has a lip inside the jar. I greatly appreciated the previous packaging for its ease of use and the fact that I could get out all of the cream. The new lip will make this much more difficult. Very disappointed and I really hope they go back to the old packing cause it was definitely a 5 star product before this change.

avis.titre: Not a good eye cream any more
avis.texte: The quality of Origins have gone down hills, the eye cream is not the same, and It's size shrink significantly, you order a full size and only get half of a bottle filled. will no longer shop hours again.

avis.titre: I do love the Orgin line
avis.texte: I have called twice now about not receiving my order. It said it was delivered, but i have not received it! This was last week. Not happy!

I won't be buying Origins after opening this eye cream and finding a large bubble of empty space in the container. I bought 2 of the same EXPENSIVE creams, and there's a bubble in BOTH containers. In fact, there were bubbles in ALL cream containers of my recent purchases. See photos. I have loved and used your products for 25+ years. This has happened to me before. I cannot trust a company that doesn't send completely filled containers of wildly expensive products.

Love this eye cream been using for 10 plus years!! They changed the packaging. The jar looks smaller and there's barely half of product in it.It is not a damaged issue I have checked over a dozen jars in different stores all the same! Why less product. ? Bring back old jar it is very misleading. If this doesn't change, I will not be re-buying it.

avis.titre: It's part of my daily routine
avis.texte: It's part of my daily routine; my eyes look less tired and the bags under my eyes have diminished. Highly recommended.
5 days after I ordered it, Origins sent me an update about a price-increase and charged me more than my purchase price, just like that! This is unethical, and I will never purchase from you again!
honestly the best product i have ever used. i have insomnia, so my eyes used to look awful, but when i started using this the shadows under my eyes simply disappeared.

Of course! Here is a short, positive review for the Origins GinZing Brightening Eye Cream: A Morning Must-Have! I absolutely love this eye cream! It's fantastic for tired mornings. The cream has a slight tint and illuminating particles that instantly brighten my dark circles, making me look much more awake. I love the cooling, refreshing sensation upon application, which helps with puffiness. It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and is the perfect pick-me-up for my eyes! Gifted by origins.

I didn't think an eye cream could double as a mini magic trick, but the GinZing Brightening Eye Cream with Vitamin C (Warm Shade) proved me wrong. It melts right in, adds the softest warm tint, and makes me look like I actually slept 8 hours even when I didn't. Bright eyes in a swipe! Complimentary from origins

Really great eye cream! Just make sure to pick the correct shade for you. Lightweight but very moisturizing. Makeup goes over it perfectly fine. Doesn't sting. I use it all around my eyes, not just below.

This is my go-to in the mornings when I look tired (aka always). It has this subtle peachy tint that instantly brightens my under-eyes, and the texture is light but creamy. It plays well under concealer and doesn't pill. I can actually see a difference after I apply it—my eyes look more awake and less puffy. If you're looking for a no-fuss, reliable eye cream, this one does the job.

I really enjoy using this product in the mornings under my eyes. It has noticeably brightened my dark circles, making me look less tired. The texture is hydrating, creamy, lightweight, and absorbs quickly. This eye cream performs remarkably well whether I apply it under or over my makeup. Although it comes in a small jar, just a few dabs are enough, and it lasts a long time. I definitely plan to keep this as part of my morning routine!
I have used this product happily for years, but 2 months ago my re-order came & I'm very disappointed. The consistency was not the same - runny & not creamy.

I love this eye cream! It makes my under eyes look much more awake. The tint is great to brighten me up. It's also very thick and hydrating. I'm not sure the vitamin c is doing much for me, but I still like the product overall. Gifted by Origins in exchange for my honest review.

While the Cool shade is my personal favorite and recommended for my skin tone, I have to say that both shades actually work really well. I was a bit skeptical about the shade recommendations, but I've been using both for a week now and I've noticed a significant brightening and reduction in dark circles. The formula is super lightweight and absorbs quickly, making it perfect for everyday use. Complimentary from origins

I really like this eye cream it leaves my eyes brighter than ever Complimentary from origins. I feel like it leaves then nice and fresh. Also, adds that extra hydration under my eyes. Also, I like how it has tint to it and covers my under gets a bit.

I actually love this eye cream. It has a touch of shimmer that is really mostly brightening and helps lighten my often sad dark under eyes. It really helps make me feel like I'm getting a boost in the morning when I apply this. It glides on easily and doesn't pill on or irritate my skin. Unsure if I perhaps for the wrong one but the eye cream I got was in the white and orange container.

This is the perfect brightening eye cream for the morning. It's tinted so it gives your undereyes that added coverage almost like a color corrector. Super hydrating and perfect under makeup. I was gifted this by Origin.

Gifted by origins I don't have very noticeable dark circles under my eyes. They are more like sunken under eyes and my skin around the eye it's very dry and using this eye cream provides moisture to the thin area and looks more illuminated.

Gifted by origins. I really like this eye cream, it feels good on the area nothing too think or light and perfect for my skin color. I love that it has the options of cool and warm tones, i think it is inclusive

Complimentary from origins. I was born with tired eyes. There's nothing I can do to completely change it but this was one of the few eye creams that made a difference. My under and above eye area looks brighter.

This eye cream is a game changer for tired eyes! I tried the Cool shade and instantly noticed a brightening effect. It gives a slight tint that helps neutralize dark circles, while the Vitamin C works over time to improve brightness. It feels super refreshing and lightweight under makeup.

I really enjoyed the brightening effects of this eye cream. I like that they offer it in two tones. I like to use the cooler one in the winter and the warmer one in the summer. Great base for concealer or just really great on its own it has small shimmers but they aren't glitter and I didn't feel it.

I've been using a pea-sized amount on my dark circles every morning and night, gently tapping it in. After about a week, I've noticed my under-eye area looks brighter—almost like I've had a full night's sleep! It comes in two shades, Cool and Warm, but honestly, I don't think the color difference is that noticeable. Gifted by origins

Gifted by origins GinZing Brightening Eye Cream with Vitamin C-Cool Shade effectively brightens and visibly reduces my dark circles. This formula hydrates and minimizes puffiness, and over time, it reduces the appearance of dark circles. In the picture, you can see that I gently patted the product on one eye with my ring finger under it. Then, I took a small amount and applied it above my eye. Surprisingly, there was no irritation, even though I have super sensitive skin. I'm actually loving this product because nothing else has helped me with my baggy, dark circles, but this one does.

I'm very excited to report that I have been using this GinZing™ Brightening Eye Cream with Vitamin C in warm almost every work day and receiving such nice compliments! This product is a great complement to the no make up look!

I absolutely love this eye cream! It gives the most beautiful instant brightening affect! It's incredibly hydrating and goes on beautifully under makeup too! Love that it comes in different tones to work for all skin!

i've used this eye cream before, this is now my second container! It's great at brightening without feeling a tingle or burn. I have dry skin and it's very hydrating and brightening! it sits very nicely under makeup

This brightening eye cream works great! I have dry skin and I love it!! Love the texture and good absorption too! And I love how easy it is to apply with this packaging! I highly recommend it Complimentary from origins

I've been using this GinZing Brightening Eye Cream (gifted by Origins) in the mornings, and it really helps wake up my eyes. It brightens and makes my dark circles look less noticeable. I'm not the biggest fan of the jar packaging, but the formula itself is super refreshing and works well under makeup.

This ice cream is instantly rejuvenating and cooling on my under eyes. I love using it as my final step in my skin care routine after I moisturize my face to really make sure that my eyes feel moisturized and lightweight.

Complimentary from origins I like how lightweight the product is and that it adds a bit of color. I feel like it helps hydrate my under-eye area. I have pretty dark under-eye circles, and this product arrived at the perfect time. Look!

I like this under her eye, brightening cream because it has vitamin C and niacinamide, which is so important in helping the under the eyes. There are two tones for you to use, which are so cute. I will continue to use to see if it brings a significant difference but this is a good skincare brand

One of the best eye creams! The texture is light and refreshing, and it has a slightly cooling effect when you apply it which feels amazing, especially when your eyes are tired. It blends in easily and doesn't feel heavy or greasy under makeup. In fact, it actually works really well as a brightening base under concealer. The tint has a subtle peachy tone that helps neutralize dark circles without looking like makeup. Gifted by origins!

The texture feels light and hydrating, and the subtle pinkish-peach tone actually does help take down some of the darkness under my eyes. I don't wear a ton of makeup most days when I'm working from home, so I love that this gives a bit of a brightened, wide-awake look without needing concealer. It plays nicely under makeup too with no pilling or greasiness! Gifted by Origins for my honest review.

The Origins GinZing Brightening Eye Cream instantly makes my under eye area feel refreshed. The texture is smooth and lightweight, and the Vitamin C gives a nice brightening effect. It helps reduce the look of dark circles and sits perfectly under makeup without creasing. Gifted by origins

avis.titre: Effectively brightens the under eye area
avis.texte: This eye cream is very lightweight and sinks into the skin almost instantly without leaving any residue behind. Both the "cool" and "warm" shades are quite similar and do a great job brightening the under-eye area thanks to the light reflecting shimmer particles. The "cool" tone is slightly lighter and offers a brighter finish, while the "warm" shade has more of a golden glow. Both work well on my light to medium skin tone. While I don't struggle with dark circles or puffiness, I still enjoy using brightening eye creams to help my eyes look more awake.

I have combination skin and prefer natural skincare, so I'm absolutely loving the GinZing™ Brightening Eye Cream! At 32, I'm always looking for ways to combat dark circles and puffiness, and the "Cool" shade worked perfectly for me. It feels lightweight and truly makes my under-eye area look brighter and more refreshed. Plus, knowing it's vegan and packed with ingredients like Vitamin C and Niacinamide makes it a perfect fit for my routine. Complimentary from origins

This eye cream is amazing! It is so cooling and makes such a difference under the eyes. I'm actually obsessed with the way it looks on the skin and the way it brightens my under eyes. I love it so much! Gifted by origins

This is a great pick-me-up for my all time dark and tired looking eyes. The tinted formula instantly brightens up my under eye area and opens up the eyes. It's very hydrating and the formula feels really cool too. However, for really dark and deep set eyes this probably won't work

My under-eyes look a little more awake right away, and makeup sits nicely on top without creasing or pilling. It gives me just enough of a boost to feel pulled together. The soft tint and subtle glow are exactly what I needed without feeling overdone.

I love the ginzing line everything smells so fresh and citrusy. This eye cream leaves me feeling hydrated and refreshed. Perfect for morning or evening. I highly recommend it. Complimentary from origins

avis.titre: Brightening eye cream for warm shades
avis.texte: If you have medium-to-deep skin tones and struggle with dark under-eyes, this is the eye cream you've been waiting for. I've been using the Origins GinZing Brightening Eye Cream in Warm, and I genuinely notice a difference both instantly and over time. The golden amber tint gives a natural brightening effect that blends seamlessly into my skin without leaving any chalky cast. It almost acts like a built-in color corrector—just enough coverage to look refreshed, but still totally skin-like. I love that it's packed with Vitamin C, Niacinamide, and Caffeine—it feels soothing and depuffing in the mornings, especially if I didn't sleep well the night before. I've noticed my under-eye area looks less tired overall, and it's hydrating enough to wear under concealer without pilling. If you're someone with deeper skin and hate the way most eye creams make your under-eyes look gray or ashy, try this warm-toned version. It's radiant, never greasy, and leaves me looking like I got a full 8 hours.

I received this product, complimentary of the brand, for review. I've struggled with dark under eye circles for years. So, I was really excited to try this brightening cream. Unfortunately, the results have left a lot to be desired. I really saw no noticeable difference, with the exception of some added shimmer which helped to better reflect the light. I'm really hoping that I might see some improvement with continued use.

As someone with dark under eyes this is my new holy grail product! Complimentary from origins, this makes my eyes feel so rejuvenated and bright. It's really hard for me to find something that actually works for my dark circles but this does the trick.

This is absolutely the best eye cream for my dark circles! I love that it not only brightens my eyes with the vitamin C but also really de puffs and firms with the caffeine! The packaging is so cute and easy to take anywhere, too! Gifted by origins!

GinZing™ Brightening Eye Cream is my go-to product when I need to look more awake—think Monday morning meetings or the day after a big night out. This cream instantly leaves my under-eye area more radiant, and layers beautifully under makeup. I was gifted by Origins.

This brightening eye cream is amazing! First off, the skin around my eyes is so much more hydrated and the dewy finish from the cream really illuminates my face and brightens up my whole look! Complimentary from origins

This is a great eye cream. I love this skin care brand in general. It is made out of natural ingredients that actually work. This is a great soft, feeling eye cream. And Nurse is your under eyes and gives you a brighter under eye in just one week

I'll start with the positive…. Love the tint on this cream and does make a difference when applied although… Ive been using this eye cream for about four months now and its done absolutely nothing for my under eye pigmentation. I have slight dark blue pigmentation under my eyes and ive seen zero improvement.
This is more like a concealer for undereyes than an actual treatment to help corrections. It can be better.

I had to switch to an eye cream because of dry eye, and this is the best I found it. It's moisturizing and it seems to be softening and taking away some fine lines around my eyes couple more weeks of using it should tell the whole story. I highly recommend it for (dry) eye cream.

I have been buying this eye cream for years now. I stock up when I can. I just recently bought a couple of more due to almost finishing my last jar from my last stock up. Well I opened the new one only to be horribly disappointed to see and feel the quality change. It is so much thinner, the extra cap to keep it air tight is missing and it does not cover or brighten like it used to. I loved this product and I am so upset with this. Why would you change such a good product? More money? I would have been okay with a price increase over this horrible disaster of a new formula.
There was no difference to the dark circles under my eyes from using this product for a week. Returned.
There was no difference to the dark circles under my eyes from using this product for a week. Returned.

avis.titre: What did you do to the formula???
avis.texte: I have used this for several years and usually jump on sales to stock up and save. I recently opened the first of several containers purchased last year and this is no longer the same. It is a thinner cream and the product no longer brightens my eye area for more than a few minutes after applying. This used to be a thick, rich cream that made my eye area luminous all day. You have clearly reformulated to add more water so that customers will use up product at a faster rate and be forced to repurchase more frequently. This is a deceptive change, and far worse than if you had simply raised the price. I am really disappointed that a high-caliber brand such as Origins has resorted to such a cheap move to preserve profit margin.
Do not care for this. It felt sticky and drying tomy skin. Highly disappointed.

avis.titre: No I would not recommend this cream
avis.texte: I have been using this eye cream twice a day for three months now and it didn't really make a difference for me. I feel like the cream just sit on top of my skin and is still there the next morning. Also, I stopped using it for a few days to be sure that it was the problem and I realised my eyes itch A LOT because of this cream. However, I purchased the energizing gel cream with caffeine and niacinamide and I absolutely love it, it wakes up my skin really well in the morning!!!
Works great and love the illuminating effects. I always have several of these in my drawer.
I purchased this product and noticed the dark circles from my eyelash serum are fading.
I purchased this product and noticed the dark circles from my eyelash serum are fading.

I really wanted this eye cream to work. It does brighten and de-puff the eye area but didn't work for my dark circles and fine lines. I wasn't able to wear make up (concealer) over it because it left patches and hard to blend. I used two full bottles to try to see the difference
I have this in cool, and it's really great for a natural, bright, and awake look. I use this every morning after my skincare routine to make me look refreshed. Highly recommend!

I have been usiing this eye cream for a few months now, I am not happy with it at all. It drys up around my eyes with a white mark an does not seem to be absorbing by my skin. I actuly have to whipe the white strek from around my eys when it drys up.

This product is more of a gimmick than actually being helpful for the eye area. In fact, all eye cream products are unnecessary. The Ginseng Cream Gel moisturizer is exceptional for use on the entire face, including the eye area. Why? Because it's tested for eye area use and it is jam packed with antioxidants. This eye cream is lacking much in its formulation.

I'm on my 3rd Ginzing after finding it very refreshing as I start my care routine all mornings, creamy but light, blends well in the skin and prepares my under eyes for concealer. I've gone onto buy other products but have come back to this because it's what feels and works best!

I used a deluxe sample of this, and I have to say my undereyes looked far worse than when I started. The skin was crepey and wrinkly, but it had been looking really good with the Lilyana cream, which I had heard about from Buzzfeed. I switched back immediately. I hope it improves soon.

avis.titre: Disappointed after 2 purchases and over 1 year
avis.texte: I've been using this eye cream daily for over a year, and have purchased it twice. I have noticed recently that the skin around my eyes (where I apply it) seems to have become bleached, as if I were using a tanning bed with eye shades on. It may have helped a little with my dark circles, but not enough to justify the bleaching of the rest of the skin around my eyes. I will not buy it again, and will switch to a different eye cream.
I have bought this product in and off for years. No other product measures up.

avis.titre: Did nothing but make my under eye bags shiny.
avis.texte: I was hopeful but this did absolutely nothing. It is moist, but I would not say moistureizing as it just sits on top of the skin, makes it shine, and did nothing at all for mild dark circles after using this day and night for 30 days. I'm curious about the age group of the high star ratings. Now being in my 50's, I realize that young skin makes the market as it doesn't really take much for it to feel, look better. The real test is for ageing skin, do these product really do anything. Often they do not other than temporary moisture that you could honely get for a lot cheaper using organic coconut oil.

I use this product on my lower eyes after my normal eye cream and it works wonders to brighten and tone down discoloration. On days I don't wear makeup, It makes my eyes look bright and gorgeous. The only thing I don't like is sticking my fingers into a pot. PLEASE put this product into a tube! I'll still use it though.

avis.titre: I will not continue buying this product
avis.texte: I have been using Ginzing Brightening Eye Cream for years. The most recent purchase of this product was very disappointing. The formula seems to have changed, or this product is no longer the quality I am used to. Very disappointed. It almost feels watered down, not thick and creamy like prior products.

This is my favorite eye cream. It's tinted which I love and it goes on very smooth. It really brightens my eyes and blends well with my tinted moisturizer. I'm 52 and don't wear foundation every day and I love how well it brightens my eye area and makes me look more awake. I have mostly oily skin and this cream works well on my skin. It's not greasy.

avis.titre: They shouldn't promote for oily skin
avis.texte: I bought this thinking it would be good but it just leaves my eyelids very oily to the point I got a cyst on one eyelid. I've tried their face moisturizers as well and leaves my skin super oily dont recommend this brand for oily skin!!

I purchased this product after seeing it on tiktok and yes its hydrating and soothing and makes your undereyes appear like they are lighter for the time being. If your're looking to get rid of dark circles this isnt the product. Ive used this for a year an a half consistently every day sometimes twice a day and my dark circles are still Dark no difference at all. I will say it might help to apply before makeup as a undereye hydration and will feel good under your eye but it wont get rid of dark circles or depuffing.

avis.titre: I love this eye cream, but.....
avis.texte: I have purchased this eye cream twice without realizing I was getting the 'cool' version. I love it because it brightens my undereyes and I don't need to use another highlighter. I'm not fair skinned, but I still use the 'cool' & love this product.

I have been using this product for years and I love it. It works! The cream is light and wonderful. I have no wrinkles around my eyes at all and I'm 53. I am constantly being told I don't look my age and people are shocked when I tell them how old I am. I love Origins products and will continue to use them as long as I live.

I really wanted to like this product bc its both a tinted eye cream for immediate results and it has active ingredients for long term results. I only used it 3 times when I noticed my underyes burning the whole day. I then notice that my undereyes swelled up and they wont stop stinging. Keep in mind I do not have sensitive skin and have not ever reacted to vitamin c or niacinimide thid way before. I'm very sad and will be returning this tomorrow :(

I've been on the hunt for the perfect eye cream for a few years now, and this is it. My "racoon eyes" were gone in a couple months. Lightweight and non-greasy, absorbs quickly without a lot of rubbing, a tiny dab is enough. I use it once a day and my current jar has lasted almost 9 months. Will definitely be getting more!

i lovee this gel because not only is it brightening, it's also moisturizing! i tend to get these small spots on my undereyes if they get dry and since using this product they havent come up. ive been using it since december and i always look awake♥️

i lovee this gel because not only is it brightening, it's also moisturizing! i tend to get these small spots on my undereyes if they get dry and since using this product they havent come up. ive been using it since december and i always look awake♥️

avis.titre: i do buy this product 2 at a time!
avis.texte: this is the only product that covers my dark circles and brightens my eyes up also! LOVE THIS PRODUCT BEEN USING IT FOR YEARS!!!

been on the hunt for an eye cream to fix up dark circles, and was blown away! I only recently bought this product not expecting much of a difference right away, but saw my dark under eyes instantly become brighter! it didn't completely erase my dark circles, but it made enough of an instant change to take note of. I haven't been using this item long enough to see if it will cause milia under my eyes or any other changes, but so far extremely happy with the results so far!

I've been a long-time user of Origins Ginseng Eye Cream and I love it! It brightens my eye area, helps with dark circles on those long days at work and decreased my fine lines. Can't beat the price for such a good quality product. I keep it in the fridge for a little cooling boost as well.

avis.titre: This stuff Works! It is reducing wrinkles
avis.texte: Removing wrinkles around my eyes and mouth. Love this product!

avis.titre: Not for me - but maybe for you !
avis.texte: I am a WOC with normal skin - not oily not dry but i tend to get milia from certain products. This does work and it works well ......BUUUTTT it causes milia under my eyes after just a few uses. my husband likes it and it really does cover the under eyes well. 4 ref - I also cannot use CeraVe, it gives me bumps. So if that doesnt happen for you this will most likely work for you. Great product just not for me!
Great for first-thing-in-the-morning eyes, dark circles and bags. I only wish the iridescence was also in the facial gel cream.

I have been using this product for years but the past two times I've bought it, it has irritated my eyes immensely. I'm so sad because I loved this product and now I can't use it because it stings and hurts my eyes so much. I bought it twice hoping I just got a bad batch but it seems something has changed that has made this product terribly itchy and painful. Bummer. Please beware of buying this product!
It did nothing for dark circles or puffiness. I now have flaky skin where i used this product.
Ive tried so many eye creams for my extremely dark circles, and this works! The tinted cream visibly brightens and this is a daily go-to for me!
Love the texture and coverage of this cream. Great base to wear under concealer when you have had a late night and are trying to cover the dark circles and puffy eyes. Highly recommend!

I absolutely love this eye cream. I use it every single day. For someone with dark circles under their eyes there is no better eye cream out there (believe me ive tried them all). The only problem with this is the packaging. The orange graphics come off and get stuck on your fingers during application then you ultimately end up with little orange particles on your face.

This product definitely delivers what it promises. I love using it on days when I'm working from home or just days when I'm makeup free. My eyes look brighter almost immediately after application! The only downside is that I've tried wearing it under my eye makeup and it doesn't build well. It ends up looking cakey.
